name: 94589 · Vallejo, CA
findings: ZIP 94589 (Vallejo) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94589 (Vallejo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 94589 (Vallejo) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
